style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;autosize=1;resizable=0;textDirection=ltr;" value="These two topics are user-defined "top-level groups."<br>We want the ability to divide potential responses&nbsp;<br>up this way so that the game doesn't have to check&nbsp;<br>conditions on (as many) hundreds of infos. For&nbsp;<br>example, we may gate all "exterior" lines behind a&nbsp;<br>single invisible-continue info that checks the parent&nbsp;<br>worldspace of the actor the player is asking about,<br>so that all of those lines can be immediately skipped<br>if that actor is in an interior." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="300" x="660" y="945" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="PuXn6zqc-xqxDhx_wsCg-70" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;autosize=1;resizable=0;textDirection=ltr;" value="<div>If we aren't redirected to a different branch<br>for the actor we're asking, then we end up&nbsp;<br>at the actor-selection topics. These use&nbsp;<br>an invisible-continue info with a Papyrus&nbsp;</div><div>fragment to push the actor we're asking&nbsp;<br>about into a quest alias, so that all of the<br>infos in the results topics can run their<br>conditions against just that one alias.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="250" x="415" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="PuXn6zqc-xqxDhx_wsCg-71" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;autosize=1;resizable=0;textDirection=ltr;" value="Bribing the speaker routes back to the normal actor-selection process." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="400" x="1140" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="PuXn6zqc-xqxDhx_wsCg-73" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;autosize=1;resizable=0;" value="<div>Any <font face="Courier New">begin-asking-to</font> overrides on the speaker</div><div>will lead to alternate branches, via invisible-continue&nbsp;</div><div>infos with the appropriate conditions.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="300" x="355" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
These two topics are user-defined "top-level groups."
We want the ability to divide potential responses
up this way so that the game doesn't have to check
conditions on (as many) hundreds of infos. For
example, we may gate all "exterior" lines behind a
single invisible-continue info that checks the parent
worldspace of the actor the player is asking about,
so that all of those lines can be immediately skipped
if that actor is in an interior.

div.div:
If we aren't redirected to a different branch
for the actor we're asking, then we end up
at the actor-selection topics. These use
an invisible-continue info with a Papyrus

fragment to push the actor we're asking
about into a quest alias, so that all of the
infos in the results topics can run their
conditions against just that one alias.
